evidence.note: Strong upfront orientation: read run_tests.sh, run_tests.py, utils.py, filter.json; enumerated test counts per suite (146 c-testsuite / 221 wacc / 413 gcc-torture = 780); sampled tests across all three suites; recognized wacc as Nora Sandler book chapter progression (ch1-20) and used that structure to gauge feature scope; confirmed rustc/cargo and how pass/fail is judged.

Verified ABI/codegen details against reality by inspecting emitted assembly: diagnosed 32-bit eax zero-extension breaking sign, char offset==-1 sentinel bug, movsbq vs movzbq load selection for signed/unsigned — grounding understanding in actual x86-64 behavior not recall.

Drilled into precise C semantics: integer promotion and cast width in `(unsigned short)c ^ (signed char)0x99999999`, and rewrote common_type to follow C usual arithmetic conversions properly — treating the failing tests as a spec for the corner.

Built precise model of SysV float ABI (xmm0 return, xmm arg registers, movsd stores, static double init bit patterns) and hex-float literal parsing, feeding each finding back into codegen design across many iterations.

Late-game sustained investigation: derived that case-range over ULL scrutinee needs unsigned (ja/jb) comparison and that a large immediate must be loaded to a register before cmp — precise reference-behavior reasoning maintained to the end.

reasoning: The agent read the harness and sampled every suite up front (well past the level-5 anchor), and throughout the horizon it repeatedly drilled into the exact C construct behind each failing class — sign extension, integer promotion, usual arithmetic conversions, pointer subtraction, the SysV float ABI, struct alignment, token pasting — verifying ABI/codegen details against emitted assembly and feeding that understanding back into design, exactly the sustained 'suites-as-evolving-spec' behavior described at level 10. It falls just short of a perfect 10 because the initial corpus characterization was sampling-based rather than an exhaustive distribution analysis, with much ABI knowledge confirmed reactively via failures rather than derived proactively; hence a 9.
